verdict.line: You lose if you facetank his poison stacks and auto trades before level 3; you win if you hold R for a clean level-6 all-in with your jungler.

brief.thesis: This matchup is genuinely even (50.8% Malphite win rate over 3153 games) because Granite Shield absorbs the burst of a single Parrrley poke, but Gangplank's Grog-Soaked Blade poison punishes any trade where you stand in autos while the shield is down. Whoever dictates the range of the fight — his 625-range Q poke or your level-6 Unstoppable Force — wins the exchange.

theirWindow.when: Levels 1-2, before your W/E are up
theirWindow.what: He free-pokes you with Parrrley (5s cooldown, 625 range) with no answer from you yet. Play behind minions, take the poke on a recharged Granite Shield rather than an empty one, and don't contest cs at the edge of his range.

yourWindow.what: Unstoppable Force dashes 1000 range and knocks him up into your jungler — this is the exact kill pattern OP.GG's own data points to. Check his Remove Scurvy cooldown (22/21/20/19/18s) first; if it's up he can cleanse the knockup and heal through your damage.

start.why: 53.3% win rate over 707 games — the sustain and physical damage reduction directly answers Grog-Soaked Blade poison stacking and Parrrley chip in a lane with no all-in threat before level 6.

boots.why: 51.8% win rate, 78.8% pick rate — flat damage reduction per hit mitigates both his autoattack poison upkeep and his Parrrley auto-reset trades.

core.why: Health and armor let you absorb extended poison trades while Granite Shield recharges between fights.
64.2% win rate on this build path — grievous wounds and damage reflect specifically punish an on-hit poison attacker who has to keep auto-ing you to deal damage.
Attack speed slow compounds with your E (Ground Slam) to blunt how often his passive poison can tick.

situational.when: the enemy backline adds heavy magic burst, since Grog-Soaked Blade poison and his teammates' spells are both magic damage
the enemy team stacks additional crit or attack-speed carries alongside his on-hit poison

runes.keystoneWhy: Comet rewards landing Seismic Shard on cooldown when he overcommits to melee range for autos — it's extra poke damage you get for free on top of a trade you were already winning.

summoners.why: 51.7% win rate — Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into an actual kill once R lands, matching OP.GG's own read that this matchup is decided by a clean post-6 all-in rather than a long poke war.

playing.title: Shield first, trade second
playing.detail: Don't step back into range right after Granite Shield absorbs a hit. Let it recharge out of his 625-range Parrrley before you poke back with Seismic Shard.

playing.title: Farm behind minions vs Parrrley
playing.detail: Stand behind the wave when last-hitting under his Q range, and only push up to trade when your shield is topped off.

playing.title: Trade through W, not into it
playing.detail: Pop Brutal Strikes when he commits to melee autos — the cleave damage plus the temporary Armor/AD spike turns his on-hit poison exchange into a losing one for him.

playing.title: E his autos down
playing.detail: Ground Slam's attack speed reduction directly blunts how fast his passive poison stacks whenever he goes for repeated autoattacks.

playing.title: Save R for the level-6 gank
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force is on a 130s cooldown at rank 1 — don't burn it solo poking. Hold it for your jungler's first level-6 visit.

playing.title: Check Remove Scurvy before committing
playing.detail: His W clears CC and heals on a 22-18s cooldown. Bait it out with a Q poke or confirm it's down before you commit R, or he cleanses your knockup and sustains through the fight.

playing.title: Build into the poison, not around it
playing.detail: Sunfire Aegis into Thornmail punishes an auto-reliant poison attacker directly, while Plated Steelcaps softens the physical half of every exchange.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner spells are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG. The timing reads, trade patterns, and mechanical reasoning are original analysis built on top of those numbers.

stats.opponentTip: Use your [P] to mitigate the damage on Gangplank’s (Q)! Try to kill him after reaching level 6 with a gank!
